scope: Every user-facing public route or route template. Metadata, health, robots, sitemap, icon, and not-found responses are governed by route and production checks rather than editorial claim budgets.

unselectedProofDecisions.rationale: The About page renders five exact canonical projections for the artistic and recursive throughline; this broader proof record remains held to avoid counting the same argument twice.
The practice adds range and depth, but the current hiring argument does not require another historical example and the strongest visual artifacts still need rights and consent review.
The NYC Artist Coalition case study uses the canonical claim directly; this internal-only proof record remains a governance layer rather than an additional public proof block.
The case study preserves the coalition-level record while Jamie's exact individual production duties remain bounded.
The NYC Artist Coalition case study carries the testimony and advocacy sequence without adding another summary layer.
The canonical case-study sequence keeps the multi-year collective and institutional causality boundary intact.

surfaces.audience: hiring managers, civic-technology leaders, and trusted professional peers
surfaces.argument: Jamie creates operating structure for complex public-facing work still taking shape.
surfaces.intendedAction: Open a relevant project, view the resume, or make contact.
surfaces.omissionRationale: The homepage establishes category and range; detailed evidence, historical projects, and research governance belong deeper in the site.

surfaces.audience: readers comparing Jamie's work across civic, cultural, business, and technical settings
surfaces.argument: The same operating method appears across distinct projects without making those projects interchangeable.
surfaces.intendedAction: Choose the most relevant case study.
surfaces.omissionRationale: The index uses one compact role-and-result signal per project and leaves source density to case studies.

surfaces.audience: technical project, product operations, implementation, and public-sector delivery hiring readers
surfaces.argument: Jamie can create an operating backbone across ambiguous multidisciplinary work.
surfaces.intendedAction: Trace a capability to a project and then view or download the resume.
surfaces.omissionRationale: Only claims that transfer directly to operating-backbone work appear; artistic and archival depth remains available in projects and the bank.

surfaces.audience: application reviewers who need a fast, conventional professional artifact
surfaces.argument: Jamie has sustained, source-disciplined experience across technical project management, product operations, and implementation.
surfaces.intendedAction: Download the approved phone-bearing PDF or contact Jamie through the site.
surfaces.omissionRationale: The resume favors role fit and compressed evidence; the PDF and HTML may differ intentionally where one bounded proof better fits the format.

surfaces.audience: readers who want to understand the person, method, and artistic-civic throughline behind the operating work
surfaces.argument: Jamie's systems practice grows from participation, attention, recursive social structure, and care for how people inhabit institutions.
surfaces.intendedAction: Return to the work with a richer understanding of the method or make contact.
surfaces.omissionRationale: The page preserves one threshold connecting artistic, civic, technical, and social practice; it does not become a complete biography or faculty archive.

surfaces.audience: people ready to discuss a role, project, collaboration, or source correction
surfaces.argument: There is a clear, low-friction way to reach Jamie without publishing private contact data.
surfaces.intendedAction: Send an email or follow an approved professional profile.
surfaces.omissionRationale: Contact is an action surface, not another proof surface; the phone number stays inside the approved resume PDF.

surfaces.audience: readers interested in how the portfolio was made and governed
surfaces.argument: The site uses ordinary web technology and explicit source, privacy, and accessibility boundaries.
surfaces.intendedAction: Understand the site's method without entering the private archive or internal bank.
surfaces.omissionRationale: Implementation and governance notes stay concise; the internal knowledge bank is not exposed as a public product.

surfaces.audience: peers exploring source-backed team knowledge and AI-assisted research operations
surfaces.argument: A developing method can make claims, evidence, boundaries, corrections, and projection decisions more inspectable.
surfaces.intendedAction: Review the method as a lab artifact and discuss a bounded pilot.
surfaces.omissionRationale: The lab omits private collaborators, transcripts, pricing, protected locators, and any claim of production SaaS or automated trust.

surfaces.audience: readers evaluating one project in depth
surfaces.argument: Each project shows context, Jamie's bounded action, what became usable, evidence, and limits.
surfaces.intendedAction: Inspect the evidence, compare another case, view technical operations, or contact Jamie.
surfaces.omissionRationale: Each instance receives only its argument-bearing proof set. Eligible but unselected claims remain held in the canonical projection map rather than being dumped onto the page.
